title: AAPS Random restart since upgrade to V2.7
symptom: Since upgrade to AAPS 2.7, the app restarts on its own a few times a day randomly, whether using another app or not. Same issue persists in 2.8. Android logcat shows an AutoPowerKill that kills the app.
cause: Phone-specific power optimization (AutoPowerKill) kills the app, despite disabling all power optimization and notification settings for AAPS.
fix: No definitive fix; suggested to try phone-specific settings from About dialog, but user reports it's impossible to manage. User plans to change ROM or revert to MIUI 11.
evidence_quote: in android's logcat there is an AutoPowerKill that kills the app.
